allow: Bash(docker compose exec -T php vendor/bin/php-cs-fixer fix --dry-run:*)
Bash(docker compose exec -T php vendor/bin/rector process --dry-run:*)
Bash(docker compose exec -T php bin/console doctrine:migrations:status:*)
Bash(docker compose exec -T php bin/console doctrine:migrations:diff:*)
Bash(docker compose exec -T php bin/console doctrine:schema:validate:*)
Bash(docker compose exec -T php bin/console debug:*)
Bash(docker compose exec -T php bin/console cache:clear:*)
deny: Bash(docker compose exec -T php bin/console doctrine:migrations:migrate:*)

hooks.command: FILES=$(git diff --name-only HEAD -- '*.php' | tr '\n' ' ') && [ -n "$FILES" ] && docker compose exec -T php vendor/bin/php-cs-fixer fix --dry-run --diff $FILES || true
